sentences.zh: 紹興帥張津獻羨餘四十萬緡，雄乞降旨下紹興，以其錢為民代輸和買身丁折帛錢之半，使取諸民者，民復得之，足以見聖主之德。

translations.literal: The Shaoxing commander Zhang Jin presented a surplus of four hundred thousand strings of cash; Xiong requested that an edict be sent to Shaoxing to use this money to pay half the commutation tax for corvée and cloth purchase on the people's behalf, so that what had been taken from the people would return to them—enough to show the sage ruler's virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaoxing commander Zhang Jin presented a surplus of four hundred thousand strings of cash; Xiong requested that an edict be sent to Shaoxing to use this money to pay half the commutation tax for corvée and cloth purchase on the people's behalf, so that what had been taken from the people would return to them—enough to show the sage ruler's virtue.

sentences.zh: 自雄獨相，蜀人在朝者僅十數。

translations.literal: Since Xiong served alone as councilor, Shu men at court numbered only a dozen or so.
translations.idiomatic: Since Xiong served alone as councilor, Shu men at court numbered only a dozen or so.

sentences.zh: 及眷衰，有言其私里黨者，上疑之。

translations.literal: When imperial favor waned, some spoke of his private favoritism toward his clique, and the emperor grew suspicious.
translations.idiomatic: When imperial favor waned, some spoke of his private favoritism toward his clique, and the emperor grew suspicious.

sentences.zh: 已而陳峴為四川制置，王渥為茶馬，命從中出。

translations.literal: Soon after, Chen Xian was made Sichuan commissioner and Wang Wo tea-and-horse commissioner; the appointments came directly from the center.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, Chen Xian was made Sichuan commissioner and Wang Wo tea-and-horse commissioner; the appointments came directly from the center.

sentences.zh: 雄求去，詔勉留，曰：「丞相任事不避怨，選才無鄉舊。」

translations.literal: Xiong requested to leave; an edict urged him to stay, saying: "The chief councilor handles affairs without avoiding resentment and selects talent without regard to hometown ties."
translations.idiomatic: Xiong requested to leave; an edict urged him to stay, saying, "The chief councilor handles affairs without avoiding resentment and selects talent without regard to hometown ties."

sentences.zh: 蓋有所激也。

translations.literal: This was evidently meant as a rebuke.
translations.idiomatic: This was evidently meant as a rebuke.

sentences.zh: 祖宗時蜀人未嘗除蜀帥，雄請外，除觀文殿大學士、四川制置使。

translations.literal: In the time of the ancestors, Shu men were never appointed Shu commanders; Xiong requested an outside post and was appointed grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and Sichuan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the time of the ancestors, Shu men were never appointed Shu commanders; Xiong requested an outside post and was appointed grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and Sichuan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 王藺為御史，以故事不可，上疏論之。

translations.literal: Wang Lin served as censor and, citing precedent that this was impermissible, submitted a memorial arguing against it.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lin served as censor and, citing precedent that this was impermissible, submitted a memorial arguing against it.

sentences.zh: 雄乞免，改知瀘南安撫使。

translations.literal: Xiong requested exemption and was changed to pacification commissioner of Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong requested exemption and was changed to pacification commissioner of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 上思雄不忘，改知江陵府。

translations.literal: The emperor, remembering Xiong fondly, changed his appointment to prefect of Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, remembering Xiong fondly, changed his appointment to prefect of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 江陵無險可恃，雄請城江陵，城成，民不告擾。

translations.literal: Jiangling had no natural defenses to rely on; Xiong requested fortification of Jiangling. When the walls were completed, the people reported no disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangling had no natural defenses to rely on; Xiong requested fortification of Jiangling. When the walls were completed, the people reported no disturbance.

sentences.zh: 張栻再被召，論恢復固當，第其計非是，即奏疏。

translations.literal: Zhang Shi was again summoned; he argued that recovery was certainly right but that the plan was wrong, and immediately submitted a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shi was again summoned; he argued that recovery was certainly right but that the plan was wrong, and immediately submitted a memorial.

sentences.zh: 孝宗大喜，翌日以疏宣示，且手詔云：「恢復當如栻所陳方是。」

translations.literal: Xiaozong was greatly pleased; the next day he displayed the memorial and also issued a handwritten edict saying: "Recovery should follow exactly what Shi has set forth."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong was greatly pleased; the next day he displayed the memorial and also issued a handwritten edict saying, "Recovery should follow exactly what Shi has set forth."

sentences.zh: 即除侍講，云：「且得直宿時與卿論事。」

translations.literal: He was immediately appointed lecturer and said: "When you are on overnight duty, I can discuss affairs with you."
translations.idiomatic: He was immediately appointed lecturer and said, "When you are on overnight duty, I can discuss affairs with you."

sentences.zh: 虞允文與雄之徒不樂，遂沮抑之。

translations.literal: Yu Yunwen and Xiong's faction were displeased and therefore obstructed and suppressed him.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen and Xiong's faction were displeased and therefore obstructed and suppressed him.

sentences.zh: 廣西橫山買馬，諸蠻感悅，爭以善馬至。

translations.literal: At Hengshan in Guangxi horses were purchased; the various tribes were moved and pleased and competed to bring good horses.
translations.idiomatic: At Hengshan in Guangxi horses were purchased; the various tribes were moved and pleased and competed to bring good horses.

sentences.zh: 上知栻治行，甚向栻，眾皆忌嫉。

translations.literal: The emperor knew Shi's governance and conduct and greatly favored him; all were jealous.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor knew Shi's governance and conduct and greatly favored him; all were jealous.

sentences.zh: 洎栻復出荊南，雄事事沮之。

translations.literal: When Shi again went out to Jingnan, Xiong obstructed him at every turn.
translations.idiomatic: When Shi again went out to Jingnan, Xiong obstructed him at every turn.

sentences.zh: 時司天奏相星在楚地，上曰：「張栻當之。」

translations.literal: At that time the Directorate of Astronomy reported that the minister star was in Chu territory; the emperor said: "Zhang Shi corresponds to it."
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Directorate of Astronomy reported that the minister star was in Chu territory; the emperor said, "Zhang Shi corresponds to it."

sentences.zh: 人愈忌之。

translations.literal: People grew even more jealous of him.
translations.idiomatic: People grew even more jealous of him.

sentences.zh: 光宗將受禪，召雄，雄上萬言書，陳修身齊家以正朝廷之道，言甚剴切。

translations.literal: When Emperor Guangzong was about to receive the abdication, he summoned Xiong; Xiong submitted a ten-thousand-character memorial expounding the way of cultivating the self and regulating the family to rectify the court—his words were very earnest and cutting.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Guangzong was about to receive the abdication, he summoned Xiong; Xiong submitted a ten-thousand-character memorial expounding the way of cultivating the self and regulating the family to rectify the court—his words were very earnest and cutting.

sentences.zh: 詔授寧武軍節度使、開府儀同三司，進衛國公，改帥湖北。

translations.literal: An edict appointed him military commissioner of the Ningwu Army and commissioner with ceremonial standing equal to the Three Excellencies, promoted him to Duke of Wei, and transferred his command to Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed him military commissioner of the Ningwu Army and commissioner with ceremonial standing equal to the Three Excellencies, promoted him to Duke of Wei, and transferred his command to Hubei.

sentences.zh: 疾甚，改判資州，又除潼川府，改隆興府。

translations.literal: When his illness grew severe, he was reassigned to prefect of Zizhou, then appointed to Tongchuan Prefecture, then transferred to Longxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When his illness grew severe, he was reassigned to prefect of Zizhou, then appointed to Tongchuan Prefecture, then transferred to Longxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 紹熙四年薨，年六十五，贈少師。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shaoxi he died at sixty-five; he was posthumously granted junior preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Shaoxi (1193) he died at sixty-five; he was posthumously granted junior preceptor.

sentences.zh: 嘉定二年，諡「文定」。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiading, he was given the posthumous title "Literary and Settled."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiading (1209), he was given the posthumous title "Literary and Settled."

sentences.zh: 權邦彥

translations.literal: Quan Bangyan
translations.idiomatic: Quan Bangyan

sentences.zh: 權邦彥，字朝美，河間人。

translations.literal: Quan Bangyan, styled Chaomei, was a native of Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: Quan Bangyan, courtesy name Chaomei, came from Hejian.

sentences.zh: 登崇寧四年太學上舍第，調滄州教授，入為太學博士，改宣教郎，除國子司業。

translations.literal: He passed the upper dormitory examination of the fourth year of Chongning, was assigned as professor at Cang Prefecture, entered service as erudite of the Imperial University, was changed to Instructor, and was appointed vice director of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the upper dormitory examination in the fourth year of Chongning (1105), was assigned as professor at Cang Prefecture, entered service as erudite of the Imperial University, was changed to Instructor, and was appointed vice director of the National University.

sentences.zh: 宣和二年，使遼。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuanhe, he was envoy to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xuanhe (1120), he was envoy to Liao.

sentences.zh: 明年，抗表請帝臨雍。

translations.literal: The next year, he submitted a bold memorial requesting the emperor to visit the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, he submitted a bold memorial requesting the emperor to visit the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 為學官積十餘年，改都官郎中、直秘閣、知易州，移相州，復召為都官郎中。

translations.literal: He served as an academic official for more than ten years, was changed to bureau director in the Department of Justice, appointed to the Secretariat Pavilion, and made, prefect of Yi Prefecture; was transferred to Xiang Prefecture and again recalled as bureau director in the Department of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He served as an academic official for more than ten years, was changed to bureau director in the Department of Justice, appointed to the Secretariat Pavilion, and made prefect of Yi Prefecture; was transferred to Xiang Prefecture and again recalled as bureau director in the Department of Justice.

sentences.zh: 與王黼議不合，鐫職，知冀州。

translations.literal: He disagreed with Wang Fu in counsel, was demoted in rank, and served as prefect of Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He disagreed with Wang Fu in counsel, was demoted in rank, and served as prefect of Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 金人再入，高宗開大元帥府，起兩河兵衛汴京，邦彥提所部兵二千五百人，與宗澤自澶淵趨韋城，據刀馬河，諸道兵莫有進者。

translations.literal: When the Jin entered again, Gaozong opened the grand marshal's headquarters and raised troops from the two He regions to defend Bianjing; Bangyan led his command of twenty-five hundred men and with Zong Ze hurried from Chanyuan toward Weicheng, holding the Daoma River, while troops from the various routes did not advance.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin entered again, Gaozong opened the grand marshal's headquarters and raised troops from the two He regions to defend Bianjing; Bangyan led his command of twenty-five hundred men and with Zong Ze hurried from Chanyuan toward Weicheng, holding the Daoma River, while troops from the various routes did not advance.

sentences.zh: 會敵兵大至，移屯南華。

translations.literal: When enemy troops arrived in force, they shifted camp to Nanhua.
translations.idiomatic: When enemy troops arrived in force, they shifted camp to Nanhua.

sentences.zh: 二帝北遷，邦彥與澤五表勸進。

translations.literal: When the two emperors were moved north, Bangyan and Ze submitted five memorials urging [Gaozong] to ascend the throne.
translations.idiomatic: When the two emperors were moved north, Bangyan and Ze submitted five memorials urging Gaozong to ascend the throne.

sentences.zh: 建炎元年五月，召還，命知荊南府，改東平府。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Jianyan, he was recalled and ordered to serve as prefect of Jingnan, then changed to Dongping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Jianyan (1127), he was recalled and ordered to serve as prefect of Jingnan, then changed to Dongping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時東州半已入金，至是圍益急，邦顏誓以死守，居數月城破，猶力戰不已。

translations.literal: At that time half of the eastern prefectures had fallen to Jin; by then the siege grew ever tighter. Bangyan vowed to defend to the death; after several months the city fell, yet he still fought without cease.
translations.idiomatic: At that time half of the eastern prefectures had fallen to Jin; by then the siege grew ever tighter. Bangyan vowed to defend to the death; after several months the city fell, yet he still fought without cease.

sentences.zh: 民義而從之，突圍以出，遂奔行在。

translations.literal: The people, moved by righteousness, followed him; breaking out of encirclement they escaped and then fled to the temporary capital.
translations.idiomatic: The people, moved by righteousness, followed him; breaking out of encirclement they escaped and then fled to the temporary capital.

sentences.zh: 有司議失守罪，將重坐之，帝以其父母妻子皆沒于敵，才貶二秩。

translations.literal: The responsible officials debated the crime of losing the city and were about to punish him severely; the emperor, because his parents, wife, and children had all been lost to the enemy, demoted him only two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials debated the crime of losing the city and were about to punish him severely; the emperor, because his parents, wife, and children had all been lost to the enemy, demoted him only two ranks.

sentences.zh: 俄除寶文閣直學士兼知江州、本路制置使。

translations.literal: Soon after he was appointed academician of the Hall of Precious Culture and concurrently prefect of Jiang Prefecture and commissioner of that circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was appointed academician of the Hall of Precious Culture and concurrently prefect of Jiang Prefecture and commissioner of that circuit.

sentences.zh: 既抵鎮，三年冬，聞父死，乃解官。

translations.literal: After reaching his post, in the winter of the third year he heard of his father's death and then resigned office.
translations.idiomatic: After reaching his post, in the winter of the third year he heard of his father's death and then resigned office.

sentences.zh: 四年，起復，知建康府，辭，不許。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he was recalled from mourning, appointed prefect of Jiankang, declined, and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, he was recalled from mourning, appointed prefect of Jiankang, declined, and was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 劇盜張琪殘徽州，邦彥遣裨將平之。

translations.literal: The fierce bandit Zhang Qi ravaged Hu Prefecture; Bangyan sent a deputy general to pacify him.
translations.idiomatic: The fierce bandit Zhang Qi ravaged Hu Prefecture; Bangyan sent a deputy general to pacify him.

sentences.zh: 改江淮等路制置發運使，以治辦稱。

translations.literal: He was changed to commissioner of transport for the Jiang-Huai and other circuits and was known for effective administration.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to commissioner of transport for the Jiang-Huai and other circuits and was known for effective administration.

sentences.zh: 言者論：「三年天下之通喪，後世有從權奪服者，所以徇國家之急。

translations.literal: Critics argued: "Three years is the universal mourning period for the empire; later ages have those who shorten mourning by special dispensation in order to meet the state's urgent needs.
translations.idiomatic: Critics argued, "Three years is the universal mourning period for the empire; later ages have those who shorten mourning by special dispensation in order to meet the state's urgent needs.

sentences.zh: 比年如權邦彥、姜仲謙，至幕職亦起復，幾習宣、政之風，望革其弊，以明人倫、厚風俗。」

translations.literal: In recent years such men as Quan Bangyan and Jiang Zhongqian, even at staff posts, have been recalled from mourning—almost the custom of the Xuanhe and Zhenghe eras. I hope this evil may be reformed to clarify human relations and strengthen custom."
translations.idiomatic: In recent years such men as Quan Bangyan and Jiang Zhongqian, even at staff posts, have been recalled from mourning—almost the custom of the Xuanhe and Zhenghe eras. I hope this evil may be reformed to clarify human relations and strengthen custom."

sentences.zh: 詔邦彥任軍賦，宜如舊，餘悉罷之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Bangyan's duties in military supplies should continue as before; all other recalled-from-mourning appointments were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that Bangyan's duties in military supplies should continue as before; all other recalled-from-mourning appointments were abolished.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年，召為兵部尚書兼侍讀。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxing, he was recalled as minister of war and concurrently imperial reader.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shaoxing (1131), he was recalled as minister of war and concurrently imperial reader.

sentences.zh: 二年，除端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the second year, he was appointed academician of the Hall of Brilliant Governance and deputy director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year (1132), he was appointed academician of the Hall of Brilliant Governance and deputy director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 初，邦彥獻十議以圖中興，大略謂：

translations.literal: Earlier, Bangyan submitted ten proposals for national revival, saying in summary:
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Bangyan submitted ten proposals for national revival, saying in summary:

sentences.zh: 「宜以天下為度，進圖洪業，恢復士宇，勿苟安于東南。

translations.literal: "One should measure by the empire, advance great enterprise, recover territory, and not be content with ease in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: "One should measure by the empire, advance great enterprise, recover territory, and not be content with ease in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 駕御諸將，當威之以法，而限之以爵。

translations.literal: In commanding the generals, one should awe them with law and limit them with rank.
translations.idiomatic: In commanding the generals, one should awe them with law and limit them with rank.

sentences.zh: 命讀講之臣，取累朝訓典及三代、漢、唐中興故事，日陳於前，以裨聖學。

translations.literal: Order the reading and lecturing officials to take the instruction codes of successive reigns and the stories of revival from the Three Dynasties, Han, and Tang and present them daily before the throne to aid the sage learning.
translations.idiomatic: Order the reading and lecturing officials to take the instruction codes of successive reigns and the stories of revival from the Three Dynasties, Han, and Tang and present them daily before the throne to aid the sage learning.

sentences.zh: 又監觀傷善妨賢之讒，偷安苟容之佞，市恩立威之姦，懷諼罔上之欺，聽其言，察其事，則忠邪判。

translations.literal: Also watch for slander that harms the good and obstructs the worthy, flattery that seeks ease and tolerates wrong, wickedness that trades favor for intimidation, and deceit that harbors resentment and misleads superiors—hear their words, examine their deeds, and loyalty and treachery will be distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Also watch for slander that harms the good and obstructs the worthy, flattery that seeks ease and tolerates wrong, wickedness that trades favor for intimidation, and deceit that harbors resentment and misleads superiors—hear their words, examine their deeds, and loyalty and treachery will be distinguished.

sentences.zh: 愛民先愛其力，寬民先節其用。

translations.literal: To love the people, first love their strength; to be lenient to the people, first economize their expenditures.
translations.idiomatic: To love the people, first love their strength; to be lenient to the people, first economize their expenditures.

sentences.zh: 朘己奉以佐國，當自執政始。

translations.literal: To reduce oneself and serve to assist the state should begin with the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: To reduce oneself and serve to assist the state should begin with the chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 分閫而屬大事，類非偏裨之所能為，必得賢臣大將然後可。

translations.literal: To divide command and entrust great affairs is generally not what subordinate officers can do—one must have worthy ministers and great generals before it can be done.
translations.idiomatic: To divide command and entrust great affairs is generally not what subordinate officers can do—one must have worthy ministers and great generals before it can be done.

sentences.zh: 制置一官可省，宜令沿江州縣各備境內，總以漕帥，上自荊、鄂、江、池，下至采石、京口，委任得人，乃防秋上策。

translations.literal: The post of commissioner may be abolished; the Yangzi-bank prefectures and counties should each prepare within their borders, all under the transport commanders—from Jing, E, Jiang, and Chi above down to Caishi and Jingkou below. Entrusting the right men is the best strategy for autumn defense.
translations.idiomatic: The post of commissioner may be abolished; the Yangzi-bank prefectures and counties should each prepare within their borders, all under the transport commanders—from Jing, E, Jiang, and Chi above down to Caishi and Jingkou below. Entrusting the right men is the best strategy for autumn defense.

sentences.zh: 宗室中豈無傑然有人望，可以濟艱難、贊密勿、留宿衛者，願求其人置諸左右。

translations.literal: Among the imperial clan there must be outstanding men of public esteem who can meet hardship, assist in secret counsel, and remain on night guard—I wish to seek such men and place them at Your Majesty's side.
translations.idiomatic: Among the imperial clan there must be outstanding men of public esteem who can meet hardship, assist in secret counsel, and remain on night guard—I wish to seek such men and place them at Your Majesty's side.

sentences.zh: 人事盡則天悔禍，不可獨歸之數。」

translations.literal: When human effort is exhausted, Heaven will regret disaster—it cannot be ascribed to fate alone."
translations.idiomatic: When human effort is exhausted, Heaven will regret disaster—it cannot be ascribed to fate alone."

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩素善邦彥，薦用之。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao had long been on good terms with Bangyan and recommended him for employment.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao had long been on good terms with Bangyan and recommended him for employment.

sentences.zh: 給事中程瑀劾邦彥五罪，三疏不報。

translations.literal: The supervisory attendant Cheng Yu impeached Bangyan on five crimes; three memorials received no response.
translations.idiomatic: The supervisory attendant Cheng Yu impeached Bangyan on five crimes; three memorials received no response.

sentences.zh: 邦彥在樞密，又言：「宜乘機者三，譬奕之爭先，安可隨應隨解，不制人而制於人哉？」

translations.literal: While Bangyan was at the Bureau of Military Affairs, he also said: "There are three occasions one should seize; like competing for precedence in weiqi, how can one respond and release as one goes, not controlling others but being controlled by them?"
translations.idiomatic: While Bangyan was at the Bureau of Military Affairs, he also said, "There are three occasions one should seize; like competing for precedence in weiqi, how can one respond and release as one goes, not controlling others but being controlled by them?"

sentences.zh: 尋兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Soon after he concurrently served as acting vice grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he concurrently served as acting vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 帝嘗對輔臣言湖南事，頤浩言：「李綱縱暴，恐治潭無善狀。」

translations.literal: The emperor once spoke to his chief ministers about Hunan affairs; Yihao said: "Li Gang is violent and unrestrained—I fear his governance of Tan will show no good record."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once spoke to his chief ministers about Hunan affairs; Yihao said, "Li Gang is violent and unrestrained—I fear his governance of Tan will show no good record."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「綱在宣和間論水災，以得時望。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Gang, during the Xuanhe era, discussed flood disasters and thereby gained timely reputation."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Gang, during the Xuanhe era, discussed flood disasters and thereby gained timely reputation."

sentences.zh: 邦彥曰：「綱元無章疏，第略虛名耳。」

translations.literal: Bangyan said: "Gang originally had no memorial at all—it was merely empty reputation."
translations.idiomatic: Bangyan said, "Gang originally had no memorial at all—it was merely empty reputation."

sentences.zh: 蓋助頤浩以排綱也。

translations.literal: This was to assist Yihao in excluding Gang.
translations.idiomatic: This was to assist Yihao in excluding Gang.

sentences.zh: 三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the third year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, he died.

sentences.zh: 邦彥與政幾一年，碌碌無所建明，充位而已。

translations.literal: Bangyan participated in government for nearly a year, accomplishing nothing notable—he merely filled the seat.
translations.idiomatic: Bangyan participated in government for nearly a year, accomplishing nothing notable—he merely filled the seat.

sentences.zh: 無子，以侄嗣衍為後。

translations.literal: He had no son and took his nephew Siyan as heir.
translations.idiomatic: He had no son and took his nephew Siyan as heir.

sentences.zh: 有遺稿十卷，號《瀛海殘編》，藏於家。

translations.literal: He left ten juan of draft writings, titled Remnant Compilation from the Eastern Sea, kept in the family.
translations.idiomatic: He left ten juan of draft writings, titled Remnant Compilation from the Eastern Sea, kept in the family.

sentences.zh: 程松，字冬老，池州青陽人。

translations.literal: Cheng Song, styled Donglao, was a native of Qingyang in Chi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Song, courtesy name Donglao, came from Qingyang in Chi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 登進士第，調湖州長興尉。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and was assigned as assistant magistrate of Changxing in Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and was assigned as assistant magistrate of Changxing in Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 章森、吳曦使北，松為傔從。

translations.literal: When Zhang Sen and Wu Xi were envoys to the north, Song served as attendant.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Sen and Wu Xi were envoys to the north, Song served as attendant.

sentences.zh: 慶元中，韓侂胄用事，曦為殿帥。

translations.literal: During Qingyuan, Han Tuozhou held power and Xi was commander of the Palace Command.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qingyuan era, Han Tuozhou held power and Xi was commander of the Palace Command.

sentences.zh: 時松知錢塘縣，諂事曦以結侂胄。

translations.literal: At that time Song was magistrate of Qiantang County and flattered Xi to attach himself to Tuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Song was magistrate of Qiantang County and flattered Xi to attach himself to Tuozhou.

sentences.zh: 侂胄以小故出愛姬，松聞，以百千市之，至則盛供帳，舍諸中堂，夫婦奉之謹。

translations.literal: Tuozhou dismissed a favorite concubine over a small matter; Song heard of this and bought her for a hundred thousand cash. When she arrived he set out lavish furnishings, lodged her in the central hall, and he and his wife served her with care.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou dismissed a favorite concubine over a small matter; Song heard of this and bought her for a hundred thousand cash. When she arrived he set out lavish furnishings, lodged her in the central hall, and he and his wife served her with care.

sentences.zh: 居無何，侂胄意解，復召姬，姬具言松謹待之意，侂胄大喜，除松幹辦行在諸軍審計司、守太府寺丞。

translations.literal: Before long Tuozhou's anger eased and he recalled the concubine; she fully reported Song's careful treatment, and Tuozhou was greatly pleased. Song was appointed staff officer of the Capital Armies Audit Office and acting vice director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Tuozhou's anger eased and he recalled the concubine; she fully reported Song's careful treatment, and Tuozhou was greatly pleased. Song was appointed staff officer of the Capital Armies Audit Office and acting vice director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury.

sentences.zh: 未閱旬，遷監察御史，擢右正言、諫議大夫。

translations.literal: In less than ten days he was transferred to investigating censor and promoted to right remonstrator and remonstrance officer.
translations.idiomatic: In less than ten days he was transferred to investigating censor and promoted to right remonstrator and remonstrance officer.

sentences.zh: 呂祖泰上書，乞誅侂胄、蘇師旦，松與陳讜劾祖泰當誅，祖泰坐真決，流嶺南。

translations.literal: Lü Zutai submitted a memorial requesting execution of Tuozhou and Su Shidan; Song and Chen Dan impeached Zutai as deserving death. Zutai was sentenced to true execution and exiled to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Zutai submitted a memorial requesting execution of Tuozhou and Su Shidan; Song and Chen Dan impeached Zutai as deserving death. Zutai was sentenced to true execution and exiled to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 松滿歲未遷，意殊怏怏，乃獻一妾於侂胄，曰「松壽」。

translations.literal: When Song's year in office ended without promotion, he was deeply discontented and therefore presented a concubine to Tuozhou, naming her 'Song's Longevity.'
translations.idiomatic: When Song's year in office ended without promotion, he was deeply discontented and therefore presented a concubine to Tuozhou, naming her "Song's Longevity."

sentences.zh: 侂胄訝其名，問之，答曰：「欲使疵賤姓常蒙記憶爾。」

translations.literal: Tuozhou was surprised at the name and asked about it; [Song] answered: "I wished to make this flawed and lowly surname often receive your remembrance."
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou was surprised at the name and asked about it; Song answered, "I wished to make this flawed and lowly surname often receive your remembrance."

sentences.zh: 除同知樞密院事，自宰邑至執政財四年。

translations.literal: He was appointed associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; from magistrate of a county to chief minister took only four years.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; from magistrate of a county to chief minister took only four years.

sentences.zh: 開禧元年，以資政殿大學士知成都府、四川制置使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaixi, he was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, prefect of Chengdu, and Sichuan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaixi (1205), he was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, prefect of Chengdu, and Sichuan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 侂胄決議開邊，期以二年四月分道進兵，命松為宣撫使，興元都統制吳曦副之，尋加曦為陝西招撫使，許便宜從事。

translations.literal: Tuozhou resolved to open the frontier, set the second year fourth month for divided advance, appointed Song pacification commissioner with Xingyuan metropolitan commander Wu Xi as deputy, soon added Xi as Shaanxi pacification commissioner with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou resolved to open the frontier and set the fourth month of the second year for a divided advance. He appointed Song pacification commissioner with Xingyuan metropolitan commander Wu Xi as deputy, soon added Xi as Shaanxi pacification commissioner with discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 松將東軍三萬駐興元，曦將西軍六萬駐河池。

translations.literal: Song led thirty thousand eastern-route troops to garrison Xingyuan; Xi led sixty thousand western-route troops to garrison Hechi.
translations.idiomatic: Song led thirty thousand eastern-route troops to garrison Xingyuan; Xi led sixty thousand western-route troops to garrison Hechi.

sentences.zh: 松至益昌，欲以執政禮責曦庭參，曦聞之，及境而返。

translations.literal: When Song reached Yichang he wished to hold Xi to chief-councilor ceremony and require court attendance; Xi heard of this and turned back at the border.
translations.idiomatic: When Song reached Yichang he wished to hold Xi to chief-councilor ceremony and require court attendance; Xi heard of this and turned back at the border.

sentences.zh: 松用東西軍一千八百人自衛，曦多抽摘以去，松殊不悟。

translations.literal: Song used eighteen hundred men from the eastern and western armies for his guard; Xi drew off many of them, yet Song was wholly unaware.
translations.idiomatic: Song used eighteen hundred men from the eastern and western armies for his guard; Xi drew off many of them, yet Song was wholly unaware.

sentences.zh: 曦遣其客納款于金，獻關外四州地，求為蜀王。

translations.literal: Xi sent his retainers to submit to the Jin, offered the four prefectures beyond the pass, and sought to be made Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Xi sent his retainers to submit to the Jin, offered the four prefectures beyond the pass, and sought to be made Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 有告曦叛者，松哂其狂。

translations.literal: When someone reported that Xi was rebelling, Song sneered at the report as madness.
translations.idiomatic: When someone reported that Xi was rebelling, Song sneered at the report as madness.

sentences.zh: 及金人取成州，守將棄關遁，吳曦焚河池還興州。

translations.literal: When the Jin took Chengzhou, the defending commander abandoned the pass and fled; Wu Xi burned Hechi and returned to Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin took Chengzhou, the defending commander abandoned the pass and fled; Wu Xi burned Hechi and returned to Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 松以書從曦求援兵，曦答以「鳳州非用騎之地，漢中平衍，可騎以驅馳，當發三千騎往。」

translations.literal: Song wrote asking Xi for reinforcements; Xi answered: "Feng Prefecture is no place for cavalry; Hanzhong is level and open—cavalry can be driven there; three thousand horsemen should be sent."
translations.idiomatic: Song wrote asking Xi for reinforcements; Xi answered, "Feng Prefecture is no place for cavalry; Hanzhong is level and open—cavalry can be driven there; three thousand horsemen should be sent."

sentences.zh: 蓋紿之也。

translations.literal: This was to deceive him.
translations.idiomatic: This was to deceive him.

sentences.zh: 未幾，金人封曦為蜀王。

translations.literal: Before long the Jin enfeoffed Xi as Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Jin enfeoffed Xi as Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 曦遺松書諷使去，松不知所為。

translations.literal: Xi sent Song a letter hinting that he should leave; Song did not know what to do.
translations.idiomatic: Xi sent Song a letter hinting that he should leave; Song did not know what to do.

sentences.zh: 興元帥劉甲、茶馬范仲任見松，謀起兵誅曦，松恐事泄取禍，即揖二人起去。

translations.literal: The Xingyuan commander Liu Jia and tea-and-horse commissioner Fan Zhongren visited Song and plotted to raise troops to execute Xi; Song feared the matter would leak and bring disaster, and immediately bowed the two men out.
translations.idiomatic: The Xingyuan commander Liu Jia and tea-and-horse commissioner Fan Zhongren visited Song and plotted to raise troops to execute Xi; Song feared the matter would leak and bring disaster, and immediately bowed the two men out.

sentences.zh: 會報金人且至，百姓奔走相蹂躪，一城如沸。

translations.literal: Reports came that Jin troops were about to arrive; the people ran in panic, trampling one another, and the whole city was in uproar.
translations.idiomatic: Reports came that Jin troops were about to arrive; the people ran in panic, trampling one another, and the whole city was in uproar.

sentences.zh: 松亟望米倉山遁去，由閬州順流至重慶，以書抵曦，丐贐禮買舟，稱曦為蜀王。

translations.literal: Song hurriedly fled toward Micang Mountain, went downstream from Lang Prefecture to Chongqing, and sent a letter to Xi begging travel expenses to buy a boat and addressing Xi as Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Song hurriedly fled toward Micang Mountain, went downstream from Lang Prefecture to Chongqing, and sent a letter to Xi begging travel expenses to buy a boat and addressing Xi as Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 曦遣使以匣封致饋，松望見大恐，疑其劍也，亟逃奔。

translations.literal: Xi sent an envoy with a sealed casket as a gift; Song saw it from afar and was greatly terrified, suspecting it was a sword, and fled at once.
translations.idiomatic: Xi sent an envoy with a sealed casket as a gift; Song saw it from afar and was greatly terrified, suspecting it was a sword, and fled at once.

sentences.zh: 使者追及，松不得已啟視之，則金寶也。

translations.literal: The envoy caught up; Song had no choice but to open and look—it was gold and jewels.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy caught up; Song had no choice but to open and look—it was gold and jewels.

sentences.zh: 松乃兼程出峽，西向掩淚曰：「吾今獲保頭顱矣。」

translations.literal: Song then traveled day and night out of the gorges and, facing west with tears, said: "I have now preserved my head."
translations.idiomatic: Song then traveled day and night out of the gorges and, facing west with tears, said, "I have now preserved my head."

sentences.zh: 曦誅，詔落職，降三官，筠州居住，再降順昌軍節度副使，澧州安置。

translations.literal: When Xi was executed, an edict stripped Song of office, demoted him three ranks, and ordered him to reside in Yun Prefecture; he was demoted again to vice military commissioner of Shunchang Army and assigned to Li Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Xi was executed, an edict stripped Song of office, demoted him three ranks, and ordered him to reside in Yun Prefecture; he was demoted again to vice military commissioner of the Shunchang Army and assigned to Li Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又責果州團練副使、賓州安置。

translations.literal: He was further reduced to vice training commissioner of Guo Prefecture and assigned to Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was further reduced to vice training commissioner of Guo Prefecture and assigned to Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 死賓州。

translations.literal: He died in Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 陳謙，字益之，溫州永嘉人。

translations.literal: Chen Qian, styled Yizhi, was a native of Yongjia in Wen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Qian, courtesy name Yizhi, came from Yongjia in Wen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乾道八年進士，授福州戶曹、主管刑工部架閣文字，遷國子錄、敕令所刪修官、樞密院編修官。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the eighth year of Qiandao, he was appointed revenue clerk of Fuzhou, supervisor of archival documents in the Ministry of Justice, then transferred to recorder of the National University, reviser at the Edict Office, and compiler at the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of the eighth year of Qiandao (1172), he was appointed revenue clerk of Fuzhou, supervisor of archival documents in the Ministry of Justice, then transferred to recorder of the National University, reviser at the Edict Office, and compiler at the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 陳中興五事，至李綱議建鎮事，上曰：「綱何足道。」

translations.literal: When he set forth the five matters of national revival and reached Li Gang's proposal to establish command posts, the emperor said: "What is Gang worth discussing?"
translations.idiomatic: When he set forth the five matters of national revival and reached Li Gang's proposal to establish command posts, the emperor said, "What is Gang worth discussing?"

sentences.zh: 謙曰：「陛下用大臣，審出綱上，宜如聖訓。

translations.literal: Qian said: "When Your Majesty employs great ministers, careful judgment should place one above Gang—this should follow the sacred instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Qian said, "When Your Majesty employs great ministers, careful judgment should place one above Gang—this should follow the sacred instruction.

sentences.zh: 今顧出綱下遠甚，奈何？」

translations.literal: Yet now one is placed far below Gang—what is to be done?"
translations.idiomatic: Yet now one is placed far below Gang—what is to be done?"

sentences.zh: 上蹙然，遂極論逾數刻。

translations.literal: The emperor frowned, and they then argued at length for more than several quarters of an hour.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor frowned, and they then argued at length for more than several quarters of an hour.

sentences.zh: 孝宗內禪，通判江州，知常州，提舉湖北常平。

translations.literal: When Xiaozong abdicated internally, [Qian] served as vice prefect of Jiang Prefecture, prefect of Chang Prefecture, and commissioner of Hubei ever-normal granaries.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozong abdicated internally, Qian served as vice prefect of Jiang Prefecture, prefect of Chang Prefecture, and commissioner of Hubei ever-normal granaries.

sentences.zh: 平辰州峒徭，加直煥章閣，除戶部郎中，總領湖、廣財賦。

translations.literal: He pacified the Dong Yao of Chen Prefecture, was granted the Direct Huanzhang Pavilion, appointed bureau director in the Ministry of Revenue, and made overall supervisor of the wealth and taxes of Hu and Guang.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified the Dong Yao of Chen Prefecture, was granted the Direct Huanzhang Pavilion, appointed bureau director in the Ministry of Revenue, and made overall supervisor of the wealth and taxes of Hu and Guang.

sentences.zh: 謙乃丞相趙汝愚客，會黨論起坐斥。

translations.literal: Qian was a client of Chief Councilor Zhao Ruyu; when factional disputes arose he was dismissed and expelled.
translations.idiomatic: Qian was a client of Chief Councilor Zhao Ruyu; when factional disputes arose he was dismissed and expelled.

sentences.zh: 後數年，起為提點成都府路刑獄，移京西運判，復直煥章閣。

translations.literal: Several years later he was recalled as judicial commissioner of the Chengdu circuit, transferred to transport judge of the western capital circuit, and again granted the Direct Huanzhang Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Several years later he was recalled as judicial commissioner of the Chengdu circuit, transferred to transport judge of the Western Capital circuit, and again granted the Direct Huanzhang Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 韓侂胄謀擾金人，令獻馬者補官，七州民相扇為盜。

translations.literal: Han Tuozhou plotted to provoke the Jin and ordered that those who presented horses receive office; the people of seven prefectures incited one another into banditry.
translations.idiomatic: Han Tuozhou plotted to provoke the Jin and ordered that those who presented horses receive office; the people of seven prefectures incited one another into banditry.

sentences.zh: 謙移書侂胄曰：「今若倚群盜行剽掠之策，豈得以敗亡為戲乎？」

translations.literal: Qian sent a letter to Tuozhou saying: "If one now relies on bandit gangs to carry out a policy of plunder, how can defeat and ruin be treated as a game?"
translations.idiomatic: Qian sent a letter to Tuozhou saying, "If one now relies on bandit gangs to carry out a policy of plunder, how can defeat and ruin be treated as a game?"

sentences.zh: 既而屢論襄帥皇甫斌、李奕罪，且求罷。

translations.literal: Soon after he repeatedly discussed the crimes of the Xiang commander Huangfu Bin and Li Yi, and also requested dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he repeatedly discussed the crimes of the Xiang commander Huangfu Bin and Li Yi, and also requested dismissal.

sentences.zh: 上諭旨薛叔似協和之。

translations.literal: The emperor issued instructions that Xue Shusi should mediate and harmonize matters.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued instructions that Xue Shusi should mediate and harmonize matters.

sentences.zh: 遷司農少卿、湖廣總領，除宣撫司參謀官。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice director of the Court of Agriculture and overall supervisor of Hu and Guang, and appointed staff officer of the pacification headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice director of the Court of Agriculture and overall supervisor of Hu and Guang, and appointed staff officer of the pacification headquarters.

sentences.zh: 金兵深入，陷應城，焚漢川，漢陽空城走，武昌震懼。

translations.literal: Jin troops penetrated deeply, captured Yingcheng, burned Hanchuan, and Han Yang fled from an empty city; Wuchang was shaken with fear.
translations.idiomatic: Jin troops penetrated deeply, captured Yingcheng, burned Hanchuan, and Han Yang fled from an empty city; Wuchang was shaken with fear.

sentences.zh: 謙以寶謨閣待制副宣撫，即日置司北岸，命土豪趙觀覆之中流，士馬溺死甚眾，餘兵皆返走。

translations.literal: Qian, as Hanlin attendant of the Baomo Pavilion, served as deputy pacification commissioner; that same day he established headquarters on the north bank and ordered the local strongman Zhao Guan to attack midstream; many soldiers and horses drowned, and the remaining troops all fled back.
translations.idiomatic: Qian, as Hanlin attendant of the Baomo Pavilion, served as deputy pacification commissioner; that same day he established headquarters on the north bank and ordered the local strongman Zhao Guan to attack midstream; many soldiers and horses drowned, and the remaining troops all fled back.

sentences.zh: 未幾，奪職，罷。

translations.literal: Before long his office was stripped and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long his office was stripped and he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 後復知江州。

translations.literal: Later he again served as prefect of Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Later he again served as prefect of Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 侂胄死，和議已決，謙復罷，奉祠。

translations.literal: When Tuozhou died and peace talks were settled, Qian was again dismissed and given a stipendary post.
translations.idiomatic: When Tuozhou died and peace talks were settled, Qian was again dismissed and given a stipendary post.

sentences.zh: 卒，年七十三。

translations.literal: He died at age seventy-three.
translations.idiomatic: He died at age seventy-three.

sentences.zh: 謙有雋聲，早為善類所予。

translations.literal: Qian had a reputation for brilliance and was early on regarded favorably by the good and worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Qian had a reputation for brilliance and was early on regarded favorably by the good and worthy.

sentences.zh: 晚坐偽禁中廢，首稱侂胄為「我王」，士論由是薄之。

translations.literal: In his later years he was dismissed in the false-learning prohibition and was the first to call Tuozhou 'my prince'; scholarly opinion therefore held him in low esteem.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years he was dismissed in the false-learning prohibition and was the first to call Tuozhou "my prince"; scholarly opinion therefore held him in low esteem.

sentences.zh: 張巖，字肖翁，大梁人，徙家揚州，紹興末渡江，居湖州。

translations.literal: Zhang Yan, styled Xiaoweng, was a native of Daliang; his family moved to Yang Prefecture, and at the end of Shaoxing he crossed the Yangzi and settled in Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yan, courtesy name Xiaoweng, was a native of Daliang; his family moved to Yang Prefecture, and at the end of Shaoxing he crossed the Yangzi and settled in Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 為人機警，柔回善諧。

translations.literal: By nature he was quick-witted, supple, and skilled at ingratiation.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was quick-witted, supple, and skilled at ingratiation.

sentences.zh: 登乾道五年進士第，歷官為監察御史，與張釜、陳自強、劉三傑、程松等阿附時相韓侂胄，誣逐當時賢者，嚴道學之禁。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the fifth year of Qiandao, served through offices to investigating censor, and with Zhang Fu, Chen Ziqiang, Liu Sanjie, Cheng Song, and others fawned on the chief councilor Han Tuozhou, slandered and expelled the worthy men of the time, and enforced the prohibition against the Learning of the Way.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fifth year of Qiandao (1169), served through offices to investigating censor, and with Zhang Fu, Chen Ziqiang, Liu Sanjie, Cheng Song, and others fawned on Chief Councilor Han Tuozhou, slandered and expelled the worthy men of the time, and enforced the prohibition against the Learning of the Way.

sentences.zh: 進殿中侍御史，累遷給事中，除參知政事。

translations.literal: He advanced to palace censor, was repeatedly promoted to supervisory attendant, and appointed vice grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to palace censor, was repeatedly promoted to supervisory attendant, and appointed vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 以言者罷為資政殿學士、知平江府，旋升大學士、知揚州。

translations.literal: Because of critics he was dismissed to serve as academician of the Hall of Literary Endeavor and prefect of Pingjiang, then soon promoted to grand academician and prefect of Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Because of critics he was dismissed to serve as academician of the Hall of Literary Endeavor and prefect of Pingjiang, then soon promoted to grand academician and prefect of Yang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時邊釁方開，詔岩與程松分帥兩淮，已而召還，為參知政事兼同知國用事。

translations.literal: At that time the border conflict had just opened; an edict ordered Yan and Cheng Song to divide command of the two Huai regions. Soon after they were recalled, and Yan became vice grand councilor and concurrently associate director of state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the border conflict had just opened; an edict ordered Yan and Cheng Song to divide command of the two Huai regions. Soon after they were recalled, and Yan became vice grand councilor and concurrently associate director of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 開禧二年，遷知樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kaixi, he was transferred to director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Kaixi (1206), he was transferred to director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 明年，除督視江、淮軍馬。

translations.literal: The next year, he was appointed supervisor of Jiang and Huai military forces.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, he was appointed supervisor of Jiang and Huai military forces.

sentences.zh: 時方信孺使金議和，值吳曦以蜀叛，議未決，曦伏誅。

translations.literal: At that time Fang Xinru was envoy to Jin to negotiate peace; Wu Xi rebelled with Shu, negotiations were unsettled, and Xi was executed.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Fang Xinru was envoy to Jin to negotiate peace; Wu Xi rebelled with Shu, negotiations were unsettled, and Xi was executed.

sentences.zh: 金人尋前議，信孺再行。

translations.literal: The Jin soon resumed the earlier talks and Xinru went again.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin soon resumed the earlier talks and Xinru went again.

sentences.zh: 侂胄趣巖遣畢再遇、田琳合兵剿敵，且募生擒偽帥。

translations.literal: Tuozhou urged Yan to send Bi Zaiyu and Tian Lin to combine forces and suppress the enemy, and also offered rewards for capturing the false commander alive.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou urged Yan to send Bi Zaiyu and Tian Lin to combine forces and suppress the enemy, and also offered rewards for capturing the false commander alive.

sentences.zh: 未幾，川、陝戰屢衄，大散關陷，敵情復變。

translations.literal: Before long battles in Chuan and Shaanxi suffered repeated defeats, Dasanguan fell, and the enemy's disposition changed again.
translations.idiomatic: Before long battles in Chuan and Shaanxi suffered repeated defeats, Dasanguan fell, and the enemy's disposition changed again.

sentences.zh: 巖開督府九閱月，費耗縣官錢三百七十餘萬緡，見和議反復，乃言不知兵，固求去。

translations.literal: Yan opened the supervisory headquarters for nine months, spending more than 3.7 million strings of official cash; seeing peace talks go back and forth, he then said he did not know warfare and firmly requested to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Yan opened the supervisory headquarters for nine months, spending more than 3.7 million strings of official cash; seeing peace talks go back and forth, he then said he did not know warfare and firmly requested to leave.

sentences.zh: 侂胄誅，御史章燮論巖與蘇師旦朋姦誤國，奪兩官。

translations.literal: When Tuozhou was executed, Censor Zhang Xie argued that Yan and Su Shidan had formed a wicked faction and harmed the state; two ranks were stripped from Yan.
translations.idiomatic: When Tuozhou was executed, Censor Zhang Xie argued that Yan and Su Shidan had formed a wicked faction and harmed the state; two ranks were stripped from Yan.

sentences.zh: 寧宗謂兵釁方開，巖嘗言其不可，許自便，復元官，奉祠。

translations.literal: Ningzong said that when the military conflict opened Yan had once said it should not be done; he was permitted to do as he wished, his original rank was restored, and he was given a stipendary post.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ningzong said that when the military conflict opened Yan had once said it should not be done; he was permitted to do as he wished, his original rank was restored, and he was given a stipendary post.

sentences.zh: 以銀青光祿大夫致仕，薨，贈特進。

translations.literal: He retired with the rank of Silver Blue-Green Glory Grandee, died, and was posthumously granted special advancement.
translations.idiomatic: He retired with the rank of Silver Blue-Green Glory Grandee, died, and was posthumously granted special advancement.

sentences.zh: 論曰：史浩宅心平恕，而不能相其君恢復之謀。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Shi Hao was even-tempered and forgiving by nature, yet he could not counsel his ruler in plans for recovery.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Shi Hao was even-tempered and forgiving by nature, yet he could not counsel his ruler in plans for recovery.

sentences.zh: 王淮為偽學之禁，毒痡善類。

translations.literal: Wang Huai initiated the prohibition against false learning and poisoned the good and worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Huai initiated the prohibition against false learning and poisoned the good and worthy.

sentences.zh: 趙雄與虞允文協謀用兵，而舊史謂二人沮抑張栻，何哉？

translations.literal: Zhao Xiong joined Yu Yunwen in plotting to use troops, yet the old history says the two obstructed Zhang Shi—why?
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Xiong joined Yu Yunwen in plotting to use troops, yet the old history says the two obstructed Zhang Shi—why?

sentences.zh: 邦彥守城力戰，惜乎助呂頤浩攻李綱，君子少之。

translations.literal: Bangyan defended the city and fought hard; it is a pity he assisted Lü Yihao in attacking Li Gang—gentlemen think less of him for it.
translations.idiomatic: Bangyan defended the city and fought hard; it is a pity he assisted Lü Yihao in attacking Li Gang—gentlemen think less of him for it.

sentences.zh: 程松、陳謙、張岩誣諛之徒，何足算哉！

translations.literal: Cheng Song, Chen Qian, and Zhang Yan were slanderers and flatterers—not worth counting at all!
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Song, Chen Qian, and Zhang Yan were slanderers and flatterers—not worth counting at all!
